object.attr: stakeholder: XML 1.0 can't store these characters, and naming the character lets the user find and remove it. Since 0.2.0. Stored text now covers each text written into a data file (CF-S37): confirm link types, names and options against 0.3.0.
object.description: If stored text holds a character from U+0000 to U+001F other than tab, LF, CR, vertical tab and form feed, Mellon shall refuse the operation with an error naming the character.
